purpose: Durable, per-artifact provenance manifest of the FIELDWISE hand-lift from the master draft into Tier 3. source_document.description: FIELDWISE_MSCA_Master_Draft.docx (Part B Draft v0), the source of truth for the reseed per plans/fieldwise_reinstantiation_plan.md.
source_document.paragraph_numbering_scheme: ¶N is the Nth non-empty paragraph in document body order, counting table-cell paragraphs in row-major order at the table's position in the body and skipping empty paragraphs. 436 paragraphs total. This reproduces the numbering used by plans/fieldwise_reinstantiation_plan.md (anchor check: the §1.1.8 heading falls at ¶80 and the §3.2 heading at ¶424). Reproducible with python-docx by iterating the document body's w:p and w:tbl children in order.

status_rule: Text present in the draft is Confirmed. Content derived by reasoning from draft text is Inferred, with the derivation stated in note. Content adopted with no draft basis is Assumed and must have a matching declaration in working_assumptions.json. Content that is missing or contradicted is Unresolved and blocks the gate that needs it. No seed invents a project fact. (plans/fieldwise_reinstantiation_plan.md §5)

operator_input_pack.authored_at: plans/fieldwise_operator_input_pack.md (the form the operator filled in; the Tier 3 file is a copy placed by ticket 6)
operator_input_pack.role: Authority for project-scoped operator decisions. Items 2 and 7 (decided and confirmed 2026-08-11) fed the selected_call.json corrections at ticket 3 and the identity-spine records in consortium/roles.json and consortium/partners.json at ticket 5 — the draft names no person, so item 7 is the only source for them. Item 6 fed deliverable D1.3 at ticket 4. Ticket 6 folded the remaining items and copied the completed pack into Tier 3, which is what makes the operator-decided records cite an in-tier source under §12.2.

fold_status_rule: A fact the operator decided is Confirmed, cited to the input pack item and its decision date. A figure the operator estimated is Assumed and carries a declaration in working_assumptions.json. A field the operator deferred or left blank stays Unresolved with the missing content named. Nothing the operator did not answer is folded as though answered (§13.3).
